imgbox.com:
**Step 1: Open imgbox and locate the upload button**
Go to `https://imgbox.com`. Click the blue **"Upload Images"** button located in the center of the homepage.

**Step 2: Choose your files**
Select the image file(s) from your local device using the file browser dialog that appears.

**Step 3: Configure settings and submit**
Set your upload options (Content Type, Thumbnail Option, Comments). Click the green **"Start Upload"** button at the bottom to submit your file.

**Step 4: Copy the public link**
After the upload finishes, scroll down to the generated links section on the completion page. Choose your desired format (e.g., **"Full Size"** or **"HTML"** / **"BBCode"**) from the dropdown menu, then click the **"Copy"** button next to the text box to copy the public URL to your clipboard.
